Digital legacy tool directory

Every tool here helps someone you trust reach your accounts, files or crypto if you die or can't manage them yourself. Each one comes with a one-line verdict.

Vaults & password managers

Password managers and vaults with emergency or legacy access.

Vaults & password managers

Bitwarden

The best-value password manager with real emergency access: trusted contacts can request View or Takeover access after a wait time you set.

Vaults & password managers

1Password

Excellent password manager, but it has no automatic emergency-access feature. Legacy planning relies on the Emergency Kit and family account recovery.

Vaults & password managers

Keeper

A solid choice with built-in Emergency Access: name trusted contacts who can request your vault after a wait period.

Vaults & password managers

LastPass Emergency Access

It works: contacts can request vault access after a wait period. LastPass's 2022 security breaches are a good reason to look at alternatives first, though.

Vaults & password managers

Dashlane

Not recommended for legacy access. Dashlane removed its Emergency Contact feature and now suggests sharing an exported vault file with a trusted person.

Platform legacy settings

Built-in legacy features and death policies from big tech.

Platform legacy settings

Google Inactive Account Manager

Free and essential if you use Google. Set it up today: after a period of inactivity you choose, Google notifies up to 10 people and can share selected data with them.

Platform legacy settings

Apple Legacy Contact

Free and essential for iPhone users. Without it, even close family can find it very hard to get into iCloud photos and data.

Photos & cloud export

Back up and export photos, files and email before it's too late.

Crypto inheritance

Pass on self-custodied crypto without exposing your keys.

Crypto inheritance

Casa

A leading multisig self-custody service with a dedicated inheritance feature for Bitcoin and other supported assets.

Crypto inheritance

Unchained

Collaborative-custody Bitcoin vaults (2-of-3 multisig) with inheritance planning. Strong for larger holdings.

Crypto inheritance

Vault12 Guard

Backs up seed phrases using trusted 'Guardians' and lets you name a beneficiary who can inherit after a 48-hour owner veto window and Guardian approvals.

Crypto inheritance

Ledger Recover

An optional, ID-based seed backup for Ledger hardware wallets. Handy for recovery, but it's a trust trade-off and isn't primarily an inheritance tool.

Estate & document tools

Wills, document vaults and end-of-life planning.

Estate & document tools

Trust & Will

Popular online tool for US wills and trusts with guided questions. Not built for Australian or most non-US jurisdictions.

Estate & document tools

GoodTrust

A broad digital-legacy platform that combines wills, a digital vault and help closing accounts after a death.

Estate & document tools

Everplans

A well-structured digital vault for life admin and end-of-life plans, with 'Deputies' who can get your information.

Estate & document tools

Prisidio

A family 'life readiness' vault with a Co-Owner and a Keyholder who can get the vault after a verified death, with identity checks via CLEAR.
